about.title: About Money Market Calculator - High-Yield Savings Analysis Tool
about.description: The Money Market Calculator is a comprehensive savings analysis tool designed to help you calculate returns on money market accounts and compare them with other savings options. This calculator analyzes interest rates, compounding frequency, minimum balances, and fees to determine actual returns on money market investments. Whether you're comparing savings accounts or planning short-term investments, this tool provides accurate calculations for money market account growth.

faq.q: What is a money market account?
faq.a: A money market account is a type of savings account that typically offers higher interest rates than regular savings accounts in exchange for higher minimum balances and limited transactions. They're FDIC insured and provide liquidity.

faq.q: How do money market accounts compare to CDs?
faq.a: Money market accounts offer more liquidity and flexibility than CDs but typically lower interest rates. CDs lock in rates for fixed terms, while money market rates can fluctuate. Choose based on your liquidity needs.

faq.q: Are there restrictions on money market accounts?
faq.a: Yes, federal regulations limit certain withdrawals and transfers to 6 per month. Many accounts also require minimum balances ($1,000-$10,000+) and may charge fees if balances fall below minimums.

faq.q: How often do money market rates change?
faq.a: Money market rates can change frequently based on Federal Reserve policy and market conditions. Unlike CDs, rates aren't locked in, so they can increase or decrease during the time you hold the account.
